scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run minify:css && npm run build:search
scripts.build:cloudflare: MHTR_DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare-pages npm run build && node scripts/prepare-cloudflare-pages.js
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:staging: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name mhtr-in --branch cloudflare-staging
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:seo && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
